proposedReadingCards.title: Our journey
proposedReadingCards.text: We wait for the bus with an adult. The bus stops. We get on and find a seat. Where will our journey take us?
proposedReadingCards.draw: Draw a vehicle you have travelled in.
proposedReadingCards.talk: Who travelled with you, and where did you go?
proposedReadingCards.imageBrief: Stationary bus at a stop, adult and child boarding safely from pavement; matching seated second panel.

proposedReadingCards.title: Roads and rails
proposedReadingCards.text: The car travels on a road. The train follows its tracks. A tram can follow rails through a town. What is the same, and what is different?
proposedReadingCards.draw: Draw a road or a railway for a vehicle.
proposedReadingCards.talk: Which vehicle needs rails? What clues can you see?
proposedReadingCards.imageBrief: Matched road, railway and street-tram panels with complete vehicles and visible supporting surfaces.

proposedReadingCards.title: Across the water
proposedReadingCards.text: The ferry waits beside the dock. Passengers board when it is safe. The ferry carries them across the water. It stops before they get off.
proposedReadingCards.draw: Draw a boat and the place where it stops.
proposedReadingCards.talk: How can an adult help us get on and off safely?
proposedReadingCards.imageBrief: Three calm ferry panels: secured at dock, underway, secured at destination; adult-supervised boarding.

proposedReadingCards.title: Look at the wings
proposedReadingCards.text: An airplane has fixed wings. A helicopter has turning rotor blades. A space shuttle orbiter had wings too, but it travelled into space. Look closely at their shapes.
proposedReadingCards.draw: Draw an aircraft and show a part that helps it fly.
proposedReadingCards.talk: Which parts stay fixed? Which parts turn?
proposedReadingCards.imageBrief: Matched factual aircraft and shuttle orbiter with clearly distinguishable wings/rotor; historical shuttle context.

proposedReadingCards.title: Vehicles at work
proposedReadingCards.text: The van carries parcels. The truck carries a larger load. A tow truck helps move a car that cannot continue its journey. Different vehicles help with different jobs.
proposedReadingCards.draw: Draw a vehicle carrying something useful.
proposedReadingCards.talk: What does your vehicle carry? What makes it suitable?
proposedReadingCards.imageBrief: Parked parcel van, goods truck and tow truck carrying secured car; comparable panels without unsafe lifting.

proposedReadingCards.title: With a trusted adult
proposedReadingCards.text: We stay together with a trusted adult. We stop back from the road and look and listen carefully. We use a suitable crossing. We keep checking as we cross together.
proposedReadingCards.draw: Draw a safe place to wait with an adult.
proposedReadingCards.talk: What could make it hard to see traffic? What would your trusted adult help you check?
proposedReadingCards.imageBrief: Adult and child wait behind kerb at suitable crossing with good sightlines; stopped traffic, no signal-only safety claim.
